rationale.conceptual: The method combines established statistical techniques (OLS, hat matrix, multivariate normal) with chemical modelling concepts (group additivity, BEP, lateral interactions) in a way that demands careful implementation but does not introduce a completely novel algorithm. Understanding the interplay of statistics and thermochemistry is non-trivial.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of 6+ stages: loading training data, fitting GA model, generating correlated perturbations, solving microkinetic model (5000 samples × 36 temperatures) with external tools (pGrAdd, Cantera), collecting results, and computing distributions. Integrating these components and handling the batch simulation workflow requires significant engineering effort and orchestration.

difficulty.reasoning: Multistep pipeline requiring OLS fitting, multivariate sampling, microkinetic solver integration, and statistical post-processing; moderate conceptual novelty but high execution complexity due to many components.

compute_estimate.reasoning: 5000 Monte Carlo runs of microkinetic simulations, each CPU-only and modest in memory (solving a small reactor model); the training dataset is tiny (164 molecules, 66 groups). No GPU acceleration is needed.
